items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I sent for Walter Brundy. Walter Brundy got back there in time, but he didn't know where to meet us at... If Walter had recorded, we'd have a good band

ctx.x: What is his real name? Full name? I know Johnson. He's wife. We had a wife. He looked like a white guy. Yeah, he wasn't much on the kind of... We didn't have but four good men when we went to Mexico. But you see, he did his picture itself. After that, he backed out. He said they were scared to go to Mexico because they had so much revolution. So I know some Mexican here at the corner from my house. I went and asked them to ask me what part. I told them, you can change. Oh, they say it's fine. Just like here.…
Ask him if he worked with Bob Thomas ever, Robert Thomas.
